description: The real product an element is, as an architect specifies it: manufacturer, name (product or model), code (product code or article number), url (its page) and notes. For doors, windows, furniture, models (imported or grouped), columns, beams, stairs and lifts. Fields left out are kept; "" clears one; product null clears them all. They show in get_element (product), the Products schedule (get_schedule kind product), IFC export (Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation) and share links. Use only details the user gave or a file contained; never invent a manufacturer or code.
name: set_product
title: Set product details
